Outlook: Q4
2023
October 1, 2023
Download report
Central banks have their work cut out for them.
Core inflation remains high and the sticky nature
of this type of inflation means that progress in
getting inflation back down to the 2% target
could take significant time. This poses serious
questions for central banks: keep rates high and
risk a recession, or reduce rates and potentially
have to deal with an overheating economy?
